pages.title: Mill Wheat
pages.text: Four Wheat in a Quern produce four Flour after 60 work. Flour shares the common wheat-flour tag, allowing compatible pack flours in dough recipes.

pages.title: Knead
pages.text: Three Flour with a Water Bucket or Water Clay Bucket make three Dough and return the vessel. One Flour with a plain Water Bottle makes one Dough. Common flour/dough tags provide compatibility.

pages.title: Bake
pages.text: Bake Dough in a furnace for 200 ticks, smoker for 100, or campfire for 600; each gives Bread. The grain progression switch controls replacing the vanilla wheat-to-bread shortcut. Other mods’ baking routes remain pack-managed.
